decisions.reason: The source sets the lettering color on green buttons; it does not change the machine's existing beige primary finish or green accent colors.
Choosing beige lettering for button markings does not alter the DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The source concerns lettering placed on control buttons, not the title, wording, position, sides, or orientation of the branded placard.
The beige button lettering is distinct from the support base's reference-matched graphics and font color.
The source does not change the support base's beige finish or its finish reference.
The lettering color does not change the dispensing button's solenoid actuation mechanism or press-and-release control behavior.
The source specifies a visual marking color and does not change the dedicated power-control method.
The button-lettering decision does not affect the spout's appearance reference, material, or fabrication method.
The source has no effect on bowl depth, capacity, geometry, or refilling acceptability.
The source changes only button lettering color and does not affect bowl removal, swapping, or clearance.
The visual choice for button lettering does not alter any mixing-quality, foam, texture, or high-speed behavior requirement.
The source does not change pour control, beverage preservation, dispensing path, dripping, sputtering, or pour sequence.
